shell.logs_empty: No logs yet. They appear after the server runs once.
shell.logs_saved_truncated: The log was too long, so only the latest part was saved: {{path}}
shell.info_check_desc: Check settings and files before starting, look for known problems in the logs, and see whether players can reach the server from outside.
shell.delete_desc: Server files are deleted too. You'll be asked once more first.
shell.delete_desc_linked: Only removes it from the list. The server folder stays.

discord.checking_body: Loading your saved Discord connection. It will show up as soon as Saba-chan is awake.
discord.connect_body: Get a pairing code and type it in your Discord server. Once connected, you can start and stop game servers from that server through the bot.
discord.pair_step_command: Type this command in a Discord channel
discord.pair_step_wait: It connects automatically once you send it
discord.pair_waiting: Waiting for the command in Discord
discord.pair_not_saved: The command went through in Discord, but we couldn't save the connection on this PC. Get a new code and connect again
discord.invalid_relay_url: Server-chan address must start with https://. http only works for testing on this PC (localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1])
discord.permission_keys_ignored: Permission settings can't be changed here and were left as before. Everything else was saved. Change permissions on the permissions screen
discord.pair_error: Couldn't get a pairing code. Check your internet connection
discord.relay_failed_body: Can't reach the Saba-chan server ({{error}}). Refresh in a moment, or reconnect if it keeps failing.
discord.relay_rejected_title: Server-chan isn't accepting this PC's connection key
discord.relay_rejected_body: This PC may have been reconnected from another PC in Discord, or its key changed. Reconnecting with a new code keeps your Discord server settings.
discord.heartbeat_rejected_title: Server-chan did not accept this PC's status report.
discord.heartbeat_rejected_too_big: {{what}} is too high: {{actual}} now, and at most {{max}} can be sent.
discord.heartbeat_rejected_invalid: One of the values sent, {{what}}, was not valid.
discord.relay_rate_limited_title: Server-chan asked us to slow down for a moment
discord.relay_rate_limited_body: Too many checks were sent in a short time. It checks again on its own shortly. You don't need to reconnect this PC.
discord.pair_pick_this_pc: If Discord asks which PC to reconnect, pick this PC. Picking another PC disconnects that PC.
discord.conn_sub_paused: Connected to Discord, but command relay is off
discord.agent_desc: This PC receives and runs the commands sent from Discord. While it is off, the bot won't answer.
discord.agent_replaced: This Discord account's PC connection moved to another PC, so it stopped here. To use this PC again, pair it again from this PC.
discord.add_server_desc: Get a new code and type it in another Discord server to connect it to this PC as well.
discord.new_guild_instances_title: Open my servers in new Discord servers
discord.new_guild_instances_desc: Discord servers connected with a pairing code get every server on this PC right away. Turn off to pick the servers for each Discord server yourself. Discord servers connected with /saba connect and no code always start with none.
discord.disconnect_desc: Disconnects this PC from every Discord server.
discord.agent_none: No AI agent is linked. Add {{url}} to an agent such as ChatGPT or Claude to let it manage the PCs of your Discord account.
discord.agent_linked: AI agent {{name}} can manage every PC of your Discord account. Last used: {{when}}
discord.agent_list_desc: Connected AI agents can control every PC on your Discord account. You can link up to 10 agents per account; click a card to disconnect it.
discord.erase_desc: Erases everything Server-chan keeps about your Discord account and disconnects this PC. Nothing is erased until you agree on the website.
discord.erase_waiting: Waiting for your consent on the website. This PC disconnects once you agree.
discord.erase_done: Your data was erased and this PC was disconnected from Server-chan.
discord.erase_expired: The consent link expired. Press the button again to erase your data.
discord.erase_disconnect_failed: Your data was erased, but this PC's connection couldn't be removed. Press Disconnect.
discord.iw_desc: Choose the words that call this server and its commands. They work the same in every connected Discord server.
discord.iw_err_invalid: '{{word}}' can't be used (1–32 characters, no commas)
discord.iw_err_unknown_command: This server has no such command
discord.instances_mode: Instances this Discord server can use
discord.instances_all_desc: New instances show up right away
discord.instances_pick_desc: Only instances you turn on are visible in Discord
discord.no_instances: No instances yet. Add one on the Servers page first.
discord.members_empty: Couldn't load members. Make sure the command relay is on, then refresh.
discord.members_refresh_failed: Couldn't refresh the member list. The list shown is from earlier.
discord.members_partial: Couldn't get the full Discord member list, so only members with permissions are shown.
discord.no_commands: This module has no Discord commands.
discord.prefix_desc: The bot answers messages that start with one of these words, and Talking Saba-chan is called by them too. You can add several.
discord.disconnect_failed: Couldn't disconnect: {{error}}. The bot may still accept commands.
discord.invite_hint: If the Saba-chan bot isn't in your Discord server yet, invite it first.
discord.channels_too_many: You can pick up to {{max}} Talking Saba-chan channels.
discord.channels_music_warn: All regular messages in {{channel}} will be deleted. Pick a channel just for songs.
discord.channels_err_conflict: The same channel can't be assigned to two kinds at once.
discord.channels_err_unknown: {{channel}} isn't a text channel the bot can use in this server.
discord.channels_err_bot: The bot couldn't be checked, so nothing changed. Unassigning still works.
discord.channels_err_moved: This Discord server moved to another PC in the meantime, so nothing was saved.
discord.perm_err_owner_fixed: The owner's level can't be changed.
discord.perm_err_generic: Couldn't load or save permissions. Make sure saba-chan is running, then refresh.
discord.perm_chatbot_cap_hint: Requests through Talking Saba-chan never go above this level.
discord.perm_import_hint: Levels given earlier on Discord are still kept on Server-chan. Pick the ones to keep here.
discord.perm_owner_mismatch: Server-chan reported a different owner ({{relay}}). The owner here stays {{owner}}. If Server-chan is right, change the owner.
discord.perm_commands_help_hint: help and list are open to every level except banned, and can't be changed.
discord.perm_err_invalid_ladder: Level names need 1–32 characters. At least one level must stay between Owner and Banned, and you can add up to 20 levels.
discord.perm_preset_reset: {{count}} command level(s) will be reset to the {{preset}} preset.
discord.perm_ladder_hint: Drag the blocks to set the order, and tap a name to rename it. Higher blocks are higher levels. Owner and Banned stay in place, and Owner, Guest and Banned can't be deleted. To swap commands, press "Swap permissions" below and pick two levels.
discord.perm_ladder_removed: People on a deleted level move to the level just below. Commands usable from it move to the level just above.

bot_settings.big_emoji_desc: A message with only one or two custom emoji is reposted as a large image.
bot_settings.member_notice_desc: Posts in the notice channel when a member joins or leaves the Discord server.
bot_settings.busy_notice_desc: Posts a notice in the notice channel while the PC is overloaded and removes it when it clears.
bot_settings.game_chat_guard: Block messages while chat link is off
bot_settings.game_chat_guard_desc: When the game chat channel has no chat link, plain messages are removed. Replies to game chat lines and messages sent with a call word stay.
bot_settings.game_chat_clear_on_stop: Clear chat when the server stops
bot_settings.game_chat_clear_on_stop_desc: When a server stops, its chat posted in the game chat channel while it ran is removed.
bot_settings.game_chat_auto_open: Turn chat link on when the server starts
bot_settings.game_chat_auto_open_desc: Opens the chat link in the game chat channel by itself while someone is on a running server.
bot_settings.music_ui_hint: Shows the current track and queue in the Singing Saba-chan channel.
bot_settings.range: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
bot_settings.not_synced: Saved, but not applied to Discord yet. It will be applied on the next connection.
bot_settings.not_loaded: Couldn't read this server's settings from Server-chan. The values shown are defaults and can't be changed. Reload once connected.
bot_settings.confirm_desc: Before running, the bot asks the person who requested it again with a Discord button. Only that person can press it. In the app, web and CLI, dangerous commands and stop/restart always ask, whatever this setting says.
bot_settings.confirm_chatbot_hint: Admin tasks picked by Talking Saba-chan and requests mixing several people always ask, whatever this setting says.
bot_settings.tts_volume_hint: How loud reading is. Separate from the music volume.
bot_settings.tts_names_desc: Say "name," before each message so listeners know who wrote it.
bot_settings.tts_voice_chat_only_hint: /tts can't be used in regular text channels. The game chat channel is the exception.
bot_settings.tts_keep_read_hint: Read messages stay in the channel instead of being deleted.
bot_settings.tts_auto_channels_desc: When 2 or more people are in a chosen voice channel, Saba-chan joins and reads every message in its chat. If several fill up, she stays in the first one. Up to 10.
bot_settings.tts_auto_channels_none: No voice channels to choose. Only voice channels the bot can see and join are listed.
bot_settings.tts_limits: Fixed limits: {{chars}} characters per message, {{perMinute}} characters per minute per person
bot_settings.sleep_desc: While asleep (/saba sleep or Good kid), the features you pick are turned off. Others keep running. Mentions get a short "I'm sleeping" reply.
bot_settings.sleep_commands_hint: Server commands, start and stop alerts, status board, game chat
bot_settings.sleep_llm_hint: Chat, joining in, reminders, AI moderation. Summarizes the chat into memory when falling asleep
bot_settings.sleep_music_hint: Music commands and the music channel
bot_settings.sleep_extras_hint: Emoji upscale, cleanup, game stats, server moderation commands and more
bot_settings.bedtime_hint: Auto sleep: falls asleep and wakes up at set times. /saba wake during sleep wakes it until the next bedtime
bot_settings.bedtime_zone: Times use this server's time zone (if not set, the zone of the server language).

discord.prefix_default_hint: Using the default {{prefix}}. It follows the app language when you change it.
discord.prefix_err_length: Prefixes can be up to {{max}} characters: {{words}}
discord.translate_commands_desc: Show translated names and descriptions of game commands in Discord slash commands. When off, only the names in the module (for example save-all) are shown.
discord.slash_desc: Choose how Discord slash commands look on this server.
discord.slash_prefix_desc: When on, commands are grouped under Saba-chan like /saba status. When off, use them directly like /status, and server management commands (permission, assign, language and so on) show only to people with Manage Server.
discord.slash_root_name_desc: With the server call word, each server shows as its first call word (like /pal). Servers without one use the instance name.
discord.private_queries_title: Show query results only to the caller
discord.private_queries_desc: Answers that only the asker needs, such as port forwarding checks, backup lists and resource usage, show only to them, keeping the channel tidy. Shared answers such as server status and players stay visible.
discord.start_notice_hint: Servers with the bell on are announced in this Discord server's alert channel when they start or stop without a Discord command (app, web, CLI, schedule, auto restart, in game, crash). Starts and stops from Discord are left out. PC alerts such as crashes and backups go to the PC owner by DM. Pick the alert channel in <link/>.
discord.full_notice_hint: Servers with the person button on post in the alert channel when they fill up or a slot opens again.
discord.full_notice_save_failed: Couldn't save the full server alert: {{error}}
discord.pc_notice_desc: This PC's alerts go to the PC owner as a Discord DM. Turn on only the ones you want.
discord.dm_group_guild: Discord servers this PC is linked to
discord.dm_crash_desc: Alerts you when a server crashes. If auto-restart is off, a Restart button is attached.
discord.dm_crash_off_warn: When off, you won't hear about crashes on Discord. They still show in the app's notifications.
discord.dm_unresponsive_desc: Alerts you when a running server stops answering status checks. If it is set to only notify, a Restart button is attached.
discord.dm_external_start_desc: Alerts you when a server starts without going through Saba-chan.
discord.dm_schedule_desc: Alerts you a few minutes before a scheduled restart, update or stop.
discord.dm_backup_desc: Which backup results are sent as a DM.
discord.dm_update_desc: Alerts you when a new version is out.
discord.dm_disk_desc: Alerts you when the drive with your servers or backups drops below 10% free.
discord.dm_offline_desc: Alerts you when this PC can't reach Server-chan for over 3 minutes while a game server is running, so you hear about a power cut or lost internet. Not sent when you close Saba-chan yourself or it updates.
discord.dm_chatbot_usage_desc: Alerts you at 50, 80 and 100% of this month's token limit, or when the balance falls below your set amount.
discord.dm_moderation_desc: Alerts you when a message looks like a problem. Sent only if you manage that Discord server.
discord.perm_inherit_hint: A higher level can use every command a lower level can.
discord.perm_add_search: Find a member to add to {{level}}
discord.perm_import_count: Import levels given earlier on Discord ({{count}})
discord.perm_moved_count: {{count}} command(s) moved away from the preset
discord.perm_fixed_hint: This command affects the whole PC, so its level can't be changed.
discord.instance_menu_hint: Open an instance to see the commands each level can use. Set member levels in <link/>.
discord.perm_people_server_wide: Member levels apply to every instance on this Discord server.

mod.no_bot: Saba-chan isn't in this server or isn't connected, so server tools aren't available.
mod.no_channels: There are no text channels Saba-chan can see.
mod.stale_hint: Some assignments point to channels that were deleted or that Saba-chan can't see.
mod.info_desc: Change the Discord channel's name and topic
mod.name: Name
mod.rename_limit_hint: Discord allows only two name or topic changes per 10 minutes.
mod.assign_desc: Choose what Saba-chan does in this channel
mod.assign_rule: A channel does one job. Music and alerts use one channel per server, so picking one moves it here. Chat, game chat and the status board can each use up to {{max}} channels.
mod.assign_too_many: You can pick up to {{max}} {{kind}} channels.
mod.assign_unavailable: Saba-chan can't post in this channel, so it can't be assigned.
mod.slow_desc: Each member can post once per interval
mod.lock_desc: Nobody can post. Server admins still can
mod.auto_desc: Deletes messages older than the keep time every 15 minutes. Pins and Saba-chan panels stay
mod.author: Member
mod.clear_confirm_hint: Pins and Saba-chan panels stay. Deleted messages can't be restored.
mod.clear_done: Deleted {{deleted}} messages. Kept {{kept}} pins and Saba-chan panels.
mod.clear_older_left: More messages older than 14 days remain. Clear again to continue.
mod.mute_desc: Blocks chat, reactions and voice. Removes them from voice if they're in a channel
mod.forever_note: Forever · Saba-chan renews it every 28 days
mod.err_BOT_MISSING_PERMISSION: Saba-chan needs the {{permission}} permission. Grant it in Server Settings.
mod.err_RENAME_LIMIT: Because of Discord's limit, the name and topic can be changed again in {{minutes}} min.
mod.err_UNKNOWN_CHANNEL: Couldn't find this channel. Please refresh.
mod.err_BOT_UNAVAILABLE: Can't reach the Saba-chan bot. Please try again shortly.
mod.err_NODE_MOVED: This Discord server moved to another PC meanwhile.
mod.err_MUTE_NOT_MEMBER: That person isn't in this server.
mod.err_MUTE_CANNOT: This member can't be muted (server owner or a role above Saba-chan).
mod.err_FORBIDDEN: You don't have the Discord permission for this.
mod.err_MUTE_TOO_LONG: The longest is 28 days. Use Forever for longer.
mod.err_generic: Couldn't do that. Please try again shortly.

discord.perm_list_hint: For each command, pick who can use it and whether Discord asks again. Higher levels can use every command of the levels below.
discord.perm_stairs_hint: Each command sits on the step from which it can be used. Higher steps can use every command on the steps below. Drag a chip to another step or click it to move it.
discord.perm_applies_to: Applies to all {{count}} instances that have this command.
discord.perm_confirm_tier_hint: Compared with the Discord confirm setting to decide whether a button asks again. App and CLI confirms stay the same.
discord.perm_confirm_tier_mixed_hint: Instances use different tiers. Picking one sets them all.
discord.perm_server_wide: This is a server-wide command, so the change shows in every instance menu.
discord.perm_line_hint: Levels above the line can start, stop, restart and create backups. People on an instance's operators list always can.
discord.perm_line_apart: {{count}} command(s) set separately stay as they are
discord.perm_swap_done: {{a}} ⇄ {{b}} · People stay where they are. Nothing changes until you save.
discord.perm_swap_none: No commands start at this level

maintenance.backups_desc: Zips up the world and save files. Backups you make yourself are never pruned.
maintenance.backup_pre_restore_hint: State right before the restore · removed automatically 15 minutes after the server starts
maintenance.backup_nothing: There are no files to back up yet.
maintenance.restore_hint: The current state is backed up first.
maintenance.restored: Restored. The state just before was backed up too.
maintenance.restored_links_missed: Restored, but {{count}} link(s) inside the folder couldn't be recreated (Windows permissions, for example). The daemon log lists the paths.
maintenance.err_restore_outside: This backup was made for a different server folder, so it can't be restored into the current one. If you moved the server folder, move it back and try again.
maintenance.err_backup_busy: Another task (backup, restore, update, ...) is running for this server. Try again when it finishes.
maintenance.err_backups_unreadable: Couldn't read the backup folder. Check the folder permissions and the disk, then try again.
maintenance.err_schedule_changed: The schedule was changed elsewhere, so it wasn't saved. Reload it and make your changes again.
maintenance.schedule_desc: Automatically start, stop, save, back up, restart, announce, update or run game commands at set times or intervals.
maintenance.schedule_date_passed: Task {{n}} is set for a date that has already passed, so it will not run. Change its date or time.
maintenance.err_every: Enter a whole number of minutes, at least 1.
maintenance.backup_unreadable_hint: This backup cannot be opened, so it cannot be restored. Unused backup content is not cleaned up until you delete it. Delete it.
maintenance.err_backup_file_locked: The server is using a file ({{file}}), so the backup could not be made. Stop the server and try again.
maintenance.err_autosave_not_resumed: The backup was made, but the server’s autosave could not be turned back on. Restart the server.
maintenance.err_backup_failed_autosave_off: The backup failed, and the server’s autosave could not be turned back on either. Restart the server.
maintenance.err_backup_save_rejected: The server refused the save command, so no backup was made. Stop the server and back up again.
maintenance.err_backup_save_unconfirmed: The server did not report that saving finished, so no backup was made. Try again shortly or stop the server and back up.
maintenance.err_backup_server_stopped: The server stopped while it was being backed up, so that backup was discarded. Check the server and back up again.
maintenance.backup_import_note: Importing adds it to this server's backup list. To put it into the server, press "Restore" in the list.
maintenance.err_import_not_backup: This file is not a backup exported by Saba-chan.
maintenance.err_import_damaged: This backup file is damaged. Export it again on the original PC.
maintenance.err_import_other_module: This backup was made on a server for a different game, so it can't be imported here.
maintenance.err_export_old_backup: This backup was made by an old version and can't be exported.
maintenance.backup_keep_snapshot_hint: Keep the game’s latest automatic backup as a Saba-chan backup. Safe while the server is running.
maintenance.backup_game_snapshot: Made by the game · restore only
maintenance.err_snapshot_not_found: The game has no automatic backup.
maintenance.start_date_hint: Counts every N days from this date. Empty means from the day you save.
maintenance.err_every_days: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to {{max}}.
maintenance.err_command: Pick a game command to run.
maintenance.server_clock: Times follow the server PC's clock ({{zone}}). Next runs are shown in this device's time.
maintenance.command_danger: This command is hard to undo. It runs at the set time without asking.
maintenance.run_code_command_failed: The server didn't take the command
maintenance.run_code_save_unsupported: This game has no save command
maintenance.danger_confirm: You're scheduling a command that is hard to undo. Press again to save.

chatbot.sync_pending: Some Discord servers weren't updated yet. They'll sync on the next connection.
chatbot.key_desc: Only this PC's daemon and Server-chan know the key. It is never shown again.
chatbot.key_replace_placeholder: Enter a new key to replace it
chatbot.key_providers: Paste a key from OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, Grok, Mistral or another major AI company, and Saba-chan connects to the right one.
chatbot.key_needed: Add a key so Talking Saba-chan can answer.
chatbot.effort_hint: How deeply Saba-chan thinks when called or in a conversation. Higher is smarter but slower and costs more. Applies to OpenAI and Claude keys.
chatbot.memory_hint: Remembers what it learns for later conversations. What it remembers about people is shared by every chatbot channel in this server.
chatbot.moderation_desc: When someone floods the chat or posts what looks like a scam (crypto or stock "leading" rooms, illegal content), the AI takes a second look. If it judges the post harmful, it DMs only the server owner or admins among the people who connected a PC to this server, with that person and a link to the message. Messages are not deleted and nobody is punished.
chatbot.moderation_hint: The AI is only called for suspicious posts (up to 20 an hour), billed to your registered API key.
chatbot.token_alert_desc: When usage passes what you set, the person who connected a PC to this server gets a Discord DM.
chatbot.token_limit_hint: Input + output tokens. You get one alert each at 50, 80 and 100%. Counts reset every month.
chatbot.balance_alert_hint: You get an alert when the API balance drops below this amount (in the provider's currency). Only for providers that report a balance.
chatbot.alert_invalid: Enter a number of 1 or more, or leave it empty.
chatbot.ambient_desc: Saba-chan can read chatter she wasn't called into and join in now and then. Most checks end with her just listening.
chatbot.ambient_hint: When off, she only answers when called.
chatbot.ambient_effort_hint: Low is recommended. If she decides to speak, she thinks once more at the conversation effort before sending.
chatbot.credit_desc: Shows the balance of the saved API key and this month's usage.
chatbot.credit_balance_unsupported: {{provider}} does not report the balance for regular API keys. Check it on their website.
chatbot.credit_balance_none: Could not get the balance right now.
chatbot.credit_usage_line: {{calls}} model calls · {{input}} input tokens ({{cached}} cached) · {{output}} output tokens
chatbot.credit_exhausted: Credit ran out ({{time}}). Saba-chan can't reply until it's topped up.
chatbot.memo_placeholder: What Saba-chan should know about this server: tone, how to address people, mood, interests. Added after the default instructions.
chatbot.err_memo: The server prompt can be up to {{max}} characters.
chatbot.relay_delete_pending: The old Talking Saba-chan settings haven't been removed from Server-chan yet. It will retry on the next connection.
chatbot.channels_moved: Pick the channels Talking Saba-chan chats in from <link/>.
chatbot.models_need_key: Save an API key to load the available models.
chatbot.models_need_guild: Connect a Discord server to load the available models.
chatbot.models_err_NO_API_KEY: The API key has not reached the server yet. Try again shortly.
chatbot.models_err_INVALID_API_KEY: The API key was rejected. Check the key.
chatbot.models_err_KEY_PERMISSION: The API key lacks the permissions it needs. In OpenAI, set the key to All or allow Models (read) and Responses (write).
chatbot.models_err_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The API key is over its usage quota.
chatbot.models_err_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the model provider. Try again shortly.
chatbot.models_err_FAILED: Could not load the model list.
chatbot.model_fallback: The chosen model ({{model}}) is unavailable, so {{fallback}} is used instead. Save to make {{fallback}} the new model.
chatbot.tool_unavailable_operator_key: The Saba-chan server cannot use this tool right now.
chatbot.tool_unavailable_provider: Your API key's company does not support this tool.
chatbot.tools_failed: Could not load the tool list.
chatbot.tools_need_guild: Connect a Discord server to load the tool list.
chatbot.guild_enabled: Use Talking Saba-chan in this server
chatbot.guild_enabled_hint: Newly connected servers start turned off.
chatbot.saba_desc: The API key, model and remaining credit shared by every Discord server. Features are turned on and off per Discord server.
chatbot.model_desc: Talking Saba-chan answers with this model in every Discord server.
chatbot.prefix_calls_guild: It answers when called with a prefix from <link/>.
chatbot.guild_desc: Choose whether Talking Saba-chan works in this server, how she answers and which tools she uses. The API key and model are set in <link/>.
chatbot.token_limit_no_balance: {{provider}} does not report the remaining credit. Use this limit to get alerts.
chatbot.token_limit_invalid: Enter a number above 0, or leave it empty.

module_audit.title: Module '{{module}}' uses capabilities it doesn't declare.
module_audit.summary: Its code uses {{perms}}, which module.toml doesn't list. Make sure you trust this module.
module_audit.ext_title: Extension '{{name}}' uses capabilities it doesn't declare.
module_audit.ext_summary: Its code uses {{perms}}, which the permissions in manifest.json don't list. Make sure you trust this extension.
module_audit.perm_stdlib_shadow: files that shadow the standard library
module_audit.unavailable: Couldn't check the code of '{{name}}'. It will be checked again when you open it next time.

trust.verified_tip: From the signed catalog and unchanged since.
trust.modified_tip: Files changed after installing from the catalog. Reinstall unless you edited them.
trust.unverified_tip: Not installed from the signed catalog. Make sure you trust its source.

notice.module_unverified: Created from a module ({{id}}) that did not come from the official catalog. Make sure you trust its source.
notice.module_modified: The module ({{id}}) changed after it was installed. Reinstall it unless you edited it yourself.
notice.extension_unverified: Enabled an extension ({{id}}) that did not come from the official catalog. Make sure you trust its source.
notice.extension_modified: The extension ({{id}}) changed after it was installed. Reinstall it unless you edited it yourself.
notice.isolated: This component's Python scripts run in an isolated environment and can reach allowed folders only. The game server process is not isolated.

create_notice.unverified: This module is not from the official catalog. Its Python scripts run isolated, but the game server it installs and runs is not isolated and runs with your account's permissions. Only continue if you trust this module.
